dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago. : Plans in the southern part of the Halmahera Group
dct_alternative_sm: Plans in the southern part of the Halmahera Group
dct_description_sm: From Netherland Government surveys between 1914 and 1928 ; Published Apr., 1938, at the Hydrographic Office, under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy.
Relief shown by form lines, spot heights; depths by soundings, tints.
Includes buoys legend, Malayan and English terms, conversion table, Tidal Information table, authorites text, Lights abbreviations.
Soundings are in fathoms, heights in feet.
Shows depths, low water areas, reefs, buildings.

Chart 1. Southern Approach to Sambaki Strait -- Chart 2. Channels between Laloein and Kajoa -- Chart 3. Foja Road -- Chart 4. Kokka Bay -- Chart 5. Patani Road -- Chart 6. Mesa Road -- Chart 7. Channel between Lata Lata and Moeari -- Chart 8. Sabatang Road -- Chart 9. Gane Bay -- Chart 10. Ngofakiaha Road -- Chart 11. Ternate Road -- Chart 12. Batoela Road -- Chart 13. Laboeha Road -- Chart 14. Goeroea Boso -- Chart 15. Southeast part of Goemorga -- Chart 16. Approaches to Laiwoei.
